units: metres, y-up; position = centre of object's base, in parent space; rotation = degrees XYZ

interpretation.summary: Climb from the entrance deck (south-west) through the robot yard, past the laser gate, over the pillars and up the conveyor ramps to the exit on the top deck (north-east).

drive.note: press_profile(): u = (t + phase) mod period; ram offset -travel (u/slam)^2, held, eased back over rise; each stage moves offset * frac; rotor angle = whole-turn cycles + spin-up / peak / coast-down from the impact; the head's glow blinks for 'warn' s before each slam; camera shake within 'shake' m on impact

sweeper.note: angle(t) = arm + rpm * 6 * t deg (level yaw convention: direction (sin, cos)); a bar kills a body it overlaps (jump over it), a ball kills within ball_r

floater.note: per pad: joint offset (0, amp sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period), 0), yaw +-yaw, tilt +-tilt (about the deck centre); flame_joint scale y flickers

jet.note: assembly.jet_pose: home bob -> (player on trigger) fly -> wait (hatch opens; the button terminal goes live) -> press -> back home

lift.note: stand on it 'wait' s -> it travels (smoothstep, 'duration' s) to the other end; a player in a call zone brings it to that end when it is empty; carries whoever stands on it

saw.note: joint k turns its group and every later one about axis through its own pivot by amp_k sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period - lag_k) degrees; the spin group also turns rpm about the axis through the blade centre; kill within radius of the blade centre and 0.7 m of its plane (normal = axis)
